text:
Anya: quick sync -> proposing 'Foglift' adaptive-slab playbook for Dedicated. TL;DR: keep slab commitments but add a short-window microburst pool that scales automatically per-slab based on recent tail latency & sequence-length distribution. want feedback on launch scope + billing semantics. :mag:

CJ: love the name. question: is microburst pool per-tenant or shared across slabs?

Anya: shared per-region but accounted per-tenant. idea: tenants draw from per-slab burst buckets; we use token-based prewarm credits for < X minutes, and fall back to billed overage for sustained usage.

Maria: billing ops needs explicit rules: define "transient" window (e.g., 3m). prewarm credits consumed first; sustained draw converts to overage invoice line item. legal wants sample invoice rows.

Sam: proto policy config (for ops + canary):
```yaml
policy_name: foglift-v0.9
slabs:
  - name: nano
    token_rate_min: 0
    token_rate_max: 50k
    base_headroom_pct: 20
  - name: standard
    token_rate_min: 50k
    token_rate_max: 800k
    base_headroom_pct: 10
  - name: enterprise
    token_rate_min: 800k
    token_rate_max: 8M
    base_headroom_pct: 5
burst:
  window_secs: 180
  max_auto_burst_pct: 200
autoscale:
  evaluation_window_secs: 60
  adjustment_granularity_secs: 30
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 20
observability:
  emit_per_slab_metrics: true
  headroom_consumption_stream: true
```

Sam: headroom adjusts +/-50% relative to base_headroom_pct based on route.p95_1m and kv_cache_hit_ratio.

ops-bot: canary-scheduler: foglift-v0.9 canary scheduled 2025-01-22T03:00Z. smoke tests pinned.

CJ: launch criteria proposals:
- slab p95 end-to-end < 400ms under 95th % synthetic microburst mix
- no regressions in route.error_rate for 72h (target < 0.6%)
- billing docs + sample invoice published
- console shows per-slab burst draw and prewarm credit usage stream

Dave: add safety rules: auto-disable adaptive scaling if p99 > baseline*1.25 for 10m, or if burst draw exceeds predicted capacity by >5x in 15m. also add daily circuit-breaker count limit (max 3 auto-rollbacks/day).

Maria: customer escape hatches: manual freeze for adaptive adjustments in Console, and an opt-out to legacy fixed slab mode. also a policy to refund obvious billing mistakes (ops review within 7d).

Anya: prioritization for alpha (3 weeks): 1) metrics gating + adjustment engine (BE), 2) console toggle + sample invoices (FE + billing), 3) canary + circuit breakers (SRE). beta (6-10 weeks): self-serve slab sizing UI, predictive prewarm add-on, cross-region spillover.

CJ: engineering asks: 2 backend, 1 infra, 1 SRE (canary), 1 frontend for Console toggle + dashboard. analytics: product needs per-slab time series (1s granularity aggregated to 1m).

Sam: ops: we need synthetic workloads: 8-12 short microbursts (10s-90s), medium tails (5-20m), and long sustained tests (1-3h). I'll generate traces and share in the repo.

Anya: I'll draft a short PRD with acceptance criteria and open GH epic foglift/alpha. booking 30m huddle tomorrow to finalize. tagging @cj @maria @sam for review. :thumbsup:

Dave: small nit -> PRD should include exact metric names (route.p95_1m, route.p99_5m, slab.burst_draw_1m) and aggregation windows.

ops-bot: smoke test template -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/foglift-smoke (internal only)

Anya: copying notes to milestone and creating issue. thanks everyone.
